items.title: Premier accepts big pay rise after initially saying it was 'out of step'

children.content: All Tasmanian parliamentarians are now receiving the full 22 per cent pay rise they are entitled to, including the premier, who previously said it was "out of step with community expectations".

items.title: Operator of Neil the seal merchandise website fined for false claims

children.content: The operator of a now-closed Neil the seal merchandise website has been fined for "falsely" claiming it was donating a portion of its profits to conservation organisations.
